label: Speeder
note: Issue #42: the one speeder Skrugs sells. Read by src/systems/vehicles/hover_model.gd (how it moves) and speeder_node.gd (how it looks, its hull and guns). It rides `hover_height` above whatever is under it (sand, floors, ramp tops) and turns ballistic when the ground drops away faster than it can follow (`launch_gap` in one frame): off the end of a ramp or over a dune crest. There is no jump button; low gravity makes it a light, floaty sled. No fall or crash damage: only gunfire hurts it.
